title: P18.4 Recovery Integrity & Mission Control Operations — atomic deferred→pending handoff, atomic canonical settlement, crash-orphan re-eligibility, liveness/recovery operations projections + UI, real multi-executor E2E
description: P18.4-A (docs/p18-4/P18_4_RECOVERY_ATOMICITY_AUDIT.md): the deferred-recovery drain popped the queue entry and persisted the shortened queue BEFORE the successor pending_recovery was durable — a crash inside that window lost the recovery signal; canonical settlement committed result, task status, recovery arm and settle marker as independent writes so a mid-chain crash orphaned a committed result or a FAILED task with no signal. Fix: drainDeferredRecovery's pop + the entire startRecovery arm chain now commit inside ONE store.immediate() transaction (rt re-read inside for CAS correctness); canonical settlement/disposition co-commits where the store allows while adapter I/O stays outside the write lock; committed-result rows without settle_complete re-enter the bounded sweep (crash-orphan re-eligibility); fault accounting (drain_attempts/settle_faults) is explicitly bounded with durable DEFERRED_RECOVERY_DROPPED evidence. PairEvidenceStore gained a test-only faultInjector seam (never set in production). P18.4-B: MissionObservability gains executionHealth/recoveryOps/operationsOverview — provenance-classified projections (persisted/observed/derived/unknown; no synthesized timestamps); routes GET /api/missions/:id/operations + GET /api/operations; MissionControl UI adds Execution health + Recovery operations sections on Mission Detail and an Operations rollup tab in System Observability — read-only, fail-closed validation, existing governed actions only. P18.4-C: real multi-executor E2E (E2E-1..9) — real child processes via production CodexCliExecutorAdapter + a second subclassed real executor proving routing; supervisor restart over durable store; injected mid-tick power loss at the handoff; born-failing retry boundedness; UNKNOWN outcome (missing result.json) never mints success or replays side effects; MC API auth/operator gates verified against the real server.
